message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts describe: Wu (吴某) acted as nominee holder of shares, concealed and transferred shares to hide assets of Hu couple, knowing that the assets are proceeds from illegal public deposit collection (非法吸收公众存款). He also falsified contract dates. The prosecution charges money laundering (洗钱) for amount 52 million. So the crime is money laundering under Chinese Criminal Law (Article 191? Actually money laundering is Article 191 of Criminal Law). Also possibly "帮助犯罪分子隐匿、转移、变卖犯罪所得及其收益" which is money laundering. Also possibly "伪造公司印章、文书" but not indicated. The main charge is money laundering. Also maybe "帮助非法吸收公众存款罪的从犯"? But the text says "应以××追究其刑事责任". Likely they want "洗钱罪". So answer: [罪名]洗钱罪<eoa>.
